# Header

Display the brand and the name of the digital service with the primary navigation. It is the most iconic UI component of the application.
See [Header guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/header/design/)

<Canvas of={HeaderStories.Basic} />

### Home Navigation

### Responsive

On small screens, you may use scrollable tabs.<br />
For a better responsive experience, we recommend to replace tab navigation and actions with a Menu Button and a SideNav.

<Canvas of={HeaderStories.Responsive} />
